gjort: Second Norway run today: the five inherited rows are now live for DryTrek too.
SP_4_H1, SP_5_H1, PD_9_H1 and FO_1_H1 are ACTIVE in the Norwegian campaign.
FO_1_H1 opened the first FO adset in that campaign, DRYTREK_NO_FO.
They were renamed to the DryTrek pattern so the data stays separable from the source store.
The Norwegian campaign now runs 25 ads, all ACTIVE.
varningar: These films came from another store and promised three things DryTrek does not: rain-proofing, a ten-second fitting time, and 30-day returns.
All three are rewritten in the Norwegian voice-over and captions. The returns line now says 14 days, which is what the shop actually gives.
PD_8_H1 also carries a burned-in English block reading Stops snow, Stops rain, Blocks gravel, 10-second fit. It is set to be painted out.
PD_8_H1 is not uploaded: HeyGen has held the render in manual moderation for over an hour. The row stays in the queue for the next run.
A real bug was found and fixed in the caption tool: its search window was too narrow for these 9:16 films, so Swedish text survived at the left and right edges.
